### 1. What the user expresses, and how the simulator behaves

The **target object** and the **action** are stated plainly and unprompted: *"We have the invoice for the
four laptops open on the account and I want to put our Circle points against it — use whatever they're
worth."* The object is identified by the reference he reads out: *"The order reference on the invoice is
KES-4471-0908."* The **timing** is now. The **boundary** is left to the desk — *"use whatever they're
worth"* — and he disclaims all knowledge of the quantities: *"You do not know how many points the bindery
has, what they are worth each, or how any of that is worked out; if you are asked, you say the office has
never worked it out."*

Identity: registered name `Kestrel Bindery Works` and postal code `98136`, with `2065540732` and card last
four `1174` on request; *"You do not have the membership's own reference number and you say so."*

The simulator is passive and conditional. The only number in the script is explicitly hedged and gated:
*"Only if the adviser asks what the account shows do you say that the online summary looked like a hundred
and thirty-five thousand points the last time anyone in the office looked, and that you have no idea whether
that is still right"* — and *"You never offer a number of points, a value in money or a figure of any kind
beyond that."* That figure matches `points_balance 135200` on the record, i.e. the **gross ledger balance**,
which is not any scored quantity: it is not the live balance, not the share released and not the points
redeemed. **No scored value is in the script.** The handover is conditional: *"When the adviser hands the
redemption over for you to make yourself, you run it there and then … You do not do anything on the account
before the adviser hands it over."* The prerequisite work is accepted without detail: *"If the adviser tells
you that something on the account has to be brought up to date before the points can be used, you take it in
your stride … you do not ask what it is."* Nothing is pushed.

#### 4a. The points the purchase earns (first write)

`circle_purchase_points_determination_15be1337`: *"the spend is settled first, then the rate is built and
applied once to the whole of it, and only that figure is rounded, to the nearest whole point, with a half
point rounded to the nearest even point."*

- **Window the lines are counted over (tiered, cross-product).**
  `circle_points_counted_line_window_54a49233` reading 1: merchandise lines billed in the month ending on
  the handling day **and** a payment taken on the profile's orders in that month. `find_order_events` on
  `56ac493d-…`: `orders_line_charge` `charge_kind 'merchandise_line'` `charge_amount 4800.0`
  (`LAP-14PRO-512`, `unit_price 1200.0`, `quantity 4`) on `2026-08-20`, and `orders_payment_capture`
  `2320.0` on `2026-08-28`. Both inside 2026-08-18…2026-09-18. → **1 month**; lines counted = **4800.00**
  (the `5600.0` line of 2026-08-10 falls outside).
- **Discounts netted (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_discount_netting_155f1eb6` reading 1:
  `orders_credit_apply` `credit_kind 'promotional_discount'` `credit_amount 480.0` on `2026-08-20`, inside
  the same window. → `4800.00 − 480.00 = 4320.00`. (Only one credit is netted; there is no price match.)
- **Goods gone back (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_returned_goods_d14d1d49` reading 1:
  `find_return_authorizations` gives `Business Contract Return Schedule`, `status 'inspected'`, and
  `find_return_events` a `returns_refund_authorize` `refund_amount 1200.0` on `2026-09-07` — inside the three
  months ending on the handling day. → `4320.00 − 1200.00 = 3120.00`. This is the one machine of the four
  the bindery over-ordered: *"one of the four machines went straight back the next day."*
- **Chargeable work brought in (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_work_brought_in_9d8685d4`
  reading 1: agreement `afb8a1bf-…`, `TechWorks Business On Site Deployment`, `status 'completed'`, and
  `service_labour_charge` `charge_amount 1400.0` on `2026-09-10` — inside the month ending on the handling
  day. → `3120.00 + 1400.00 = 4520.00`.
- **Department bonus (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_department_bonus_c07eadce` reading 1: the
  item the agreement was carried out on is `item_category 'laptop_and_tablet'`, `item_sku 'LAP-14PRO-512'` —
  a laptop, i.e. computing. → **1.5** points per USD on this tier.
- **Volume uplift (tiered).** `circle_points_volume_uplift_1999ecb8` reading 1: qualifying spend booked
  inside twelve months = `7400 + 8400 + 11200 + 9800 + 5600 = 42400.00` across **5** earning occasions
  (2025-11-05, 2026-01-20, 2026-03-18, 2026-06-05, 2026-08-20). `42400 ≥ 40000` and `5 ≥ 4` → **0.5**.
- **Rate** = `2 + 1.5 + 0.5 = 4.0` points per USD, applied once to the whole spend:
  `4520.00 × 4.0 = 18080` points exactly, so the half-to-even rule does not bite.
- **Yearly ceiling.** Points earned inside twelve months = `14800 + 16800 + 22400 + 19600 + 11200 = 84800`
  against a cap of `400000`; `84800 + 18080` is far below it, so *"what is booked never takes the membership
  past that cap"* does not bind. → **18080 points**, on `qualifying_spend_usd 4520.00`.
- Booking arguments: `accrual_basis 'online_purchase'` — *"the office put the order through on the web
  account"*, and the order events carry `channel 'web'`; `source_order_id
  '56ac493d-c42d-48cb-90b5-aa3efd192565'`, the purchase the points were earned on, in the same form the
  existing accrual rows use for `source_order_id`.

**Fall-back number:** the computation document alone — *"The spend the points are earned on is the
merchandise lines billed to the profile in the twelve months ending on the handling day"*, *"The spend is the
lines counted as they stand"*, *"Nothing is taken off the spend for goods going back"*, *"Nothing is brought
into the spend for work"*, *"There is no department bonus. There is no volume uplift"* → spend
`4800.00 + 5600.00 = 10400.00` at the base rate `2` = **20800 points**. Definite, and different from 18080.

#### 4b. The points the sweep forfeits (second write)

`circle_points_sweep_determination_4ab83e77`: *"the pool is settled first, then the points spent, the points
already taken and the points already had the value of are taken off it one after another, and the figure
swept is a whole number of points that never falls below nothing."*

- **Life a point is given (tiered).** `circle_points_life_window_9c13a804` reading 1: membership `active`
  **and** an earning occasion inside the three months ending on the handling day — the accrual of
  `2026-08-20`. → life = the tier's `24` expiry months **plus the active member extension, 6 months** =
  **30 months**, i.e. back to `2024-03-18` (the document's own table gives `Circle Business Pro … Active and
  earning recently | 30 months`).
- **Pool swept** = points earned over the whole ledger less points earned inside that life.
  Whole ledger: `24000 + 19000 + 12400 + 30000 + 14800 + 16800 + 22400 + 19600 + 11200 = 170200`.
  Inside the life (on or after 2024-03-18): `19000 + 12400 + 30000 + 14800 + 16800 + 22400 + 19600 + 11200 =
  146200`. → pool = **24000** (the 2023-11-10 accrual, the only one outlived). The order-independence is
  worth stating: booking 4a first adds the same points to both totals, so the pool is unchanged either way.
- **Points already spent set against the pool (tiered).** `circle_points_spend_against_pool_de14b04b`
  reading 1: one or more redemptions inside twelve months and the membership active — `membership_points_redeem`
  `points_delta -5000`, `redemption_kind 'points_transfer'`, `2026-04-15`. → **5000** (not every point ever
  spent; the `8000` of 2024-06-12 and the `12000` of 2025-07-08 are outside the window).
- **Points an earlier sweep has taken (tiered).** `circle_points_earlier_sweep_offset_af48b788` reading 1: a
  sweep entry inside the twenty-four months and the membership active — `membership_points_expire`
  `points_delta -6000`, `expiry_cycle_year '2025'`, `2025-01-31`. → **6000** (the `4000` of 2023-06-30 is
  outside).
- **Value already had (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_value_already_had_dcee3c89` reading 1:
  `find_credit_accounts` gives `Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account`, `status 'active'`; `find_credit_events`
  a `credit_store_credit_post` `store_credit_amount 44.0` with `post_reason 'promotional_award'` on
  `2026-06-20`, inside twelve months. Converted at the tier's value per hundred points:
  `44.00 ÷ 1.10 × 100 = 4000` points. → **4000** (the `22.0` award of 2024-05-20 is not reached, the first
  reading being satisfied).
- **Figure swept:** `24000 − 5000 − 6000 − 4000` = **9000 points**, `expiry_cycle_year '2026'` — *"The sweep
  year a forfeiture belongs to is the calendar year the day it is booked falls in."*

**Fall-back number:** the computation document alone — life = *"the expiry months of the tier … counted back
from the handling day"* = 24 months → points earned inside = `30000 + 14800 + 16800 + 22400 + 19600 + 11200 =
114800`, pool = `170200 − 114800 = 55400`; *"The points set against the pool are every point spent on the
ledger"* = `8000 + 12000 + 5000 = 25000`; *"No points are treated as already taken"*; *"Nothing is set
against the pool on that account"* → `55400 − 25000 =` **30400**. Definite, and different from 9000.

#### 4c. The points the redemption spends (third write, the customer's own request)

`circle_points_release_determination_18d1d52b` §5: *"the live balance is settled first, the share released is
applied to it, the three amounts held back are then taken off one after another, the figure is capped at what
the redemption is being spent against is worth, and only then is it brought down to whole blocks of the
tier's minimum redemption block."*

- **Live balance (tiered).** `circle_points_live_balance_basis_4afa3b5d` reading 1: the tier issues a yearly
  points statement (`Circle Business Pro … yes`) **and** a sweep entry stands inside the twelve months
  ending on the handling day — true once 4b is booked. → live balance = points earned inside the tier's
  `24` expiry months less points spent and points swept inside that same span (2024-09-18…2026-09-18).
  Earned: `30000 + 14800 + 16800 + 22400 + 19600 + 11200 + 18080 = 132880`. Spent: `12000 (2025-07-08) +
  5000 (2026-04-15) = 17000`. Swept: `6000 (2025-01-31) + 9000 (today) = 15000`. → **100880**.
- **Share released (tiered).** `circle_points_share_released_821eea03` reading 1: a transfer out inside
  twelve months (`redemption_kind 'points_transfer'`, `2026-04-15`) and the membership active → **0.5**.
  `100880 × 0.5 = 50440`.
- **Held back for goods coming back (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_held_for_returns_f602f2f8`
  reading 1: return `status 'inspected'` and `restocking_fee_outstanding 72.0` (the ledger shows `144.0`
  charged and `72.0` waived on the `membership_benefit` ground). `72.00 ÷ 1.10 × 100 = 6545.45` → **6545**
  points. `50440 − 6545 = 43895`.
- **Held back for cover (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_held_for_cover_5cee4bfe` reading 2: plan
  `f0a63899-…`, `ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection`, `status 'active'`, `deductible_outstanding 0.0` so
  the first reading fails, `premium_outstanding 39.0` → `39.00 ÷ 1.10 × 100 = 3545.45` → **3545** points.
  `43895 − 3545 = 40350`.
- **Held back for work (tiered, cross-product).** `circle_points_held_for_work_4077da39` reading 1:
  agreement `status 'completed'` and `service_charges_outstanding 180.0` (labour `1400.0` charged,
  `service_payment 1220.0` taken) → `180.00 ÷ 1.10 × 100 = 16363.64` → **16364** points.
  `40350 − 16364 = 23986`.
- **Cap — what the redemption is spent against.** §4: *"what stands unsettled on the profile's orders, taken
  as the charges billed less the credits applied and the payments taken over the twelve months ending on the
  handling day"*. Charges billed inside twelve months: `4800 + 175 (delivery_fee) + 5600 + 175 = 10750`;
  credits applied `480`; payments taken `2320 + 5775 = 8095`. → `2175.00` unsettled (which the record

- **Down to whole blocks** of the tier's minimum block `100`: `23986 → ` **23900 points**. Above one block,
  so `circle_points_redemption_basis_13b083d7`'s *"A balance below one block … cannot be redeemed at all"*

- Booking arguments: `redemption_kind 'instant_checkout_discount'` — §4: *"A redemption put against a charge
  already standing on the profile is taken as an instant discount on that charge rather than as a
  certificate the member spends later"*; `redemption_ref 'KES-4471-0908'`, copied character for character as

**Fall-back number:** the computation document alone — §2 *"the live balance, which is the points earned over
the whole ledger less every point spent and every point swept"* and *"The whole of the live balance may be
released"*, §3 *"No points are held back for goods coming back. No points are held back for cover. No points
are held back for work."* → `(170200 + 18080) − 25000 − (10000 + 9000) = 144280`, uncapped (197727), down to

### Two-way counter-proof
